Name: DS0001_Implant
Definition: Radiopaque endosseous dental implant fixture visible in alveolar bone on adult 2D OPG (UMFIH source id=0; N=522 boxes)
Inclusion: Threaded/cylindrical titanium or zirconia endosseous root-form dental implant fixture (with or without abutment)
Exclusion: Orthodontic mini-screws/plates (CLS0013/CLS0014) or natural tooth roots with metal posts (CLS0004)
BoxRule: Tight axis-aligned bounding box (AABB) enclosing full implant fixture length from apical tip to coronal platform (mean_w=0.036)
VisibilityRule: High-contrast radiopaque metallic fixture outline clearly distinguishable against alveolar trabecular bone
OverlapRule: May nest/overlap adjacent to or under CLS0002 (Prosthetic restoration / implant crown); evaluated class-aware
Approver: Ms Faiza Feroz + Dental Review Team + M. Al Shabah + A. Anik (2026-11-19)

Name: DS0001_Prosthetic_Restoration
Definition: Fixed coronal or multi-unit bridge prosthetic restoration visible as dense radiopaque crown/pontic structure on 2D OPG (UMFIH source id=1; N=1890 boxes)
Inclusion: Single full-coverage crowns (PFM/zirconia/metal) and fixed partial denture (bridge) units covering coronal anatomy
Exclusion: Direct intracoronal fillings/obturations confined within tooth crown walls (CLS0003) or orthodontic bands/brackets (CLS0013)
BoxRule: Tight AABB enclosing the coronal prosthetic restoration or connected multi-unit bridge span (mean_w=0.095)
VisibilityRule: Distinct radiopaque coronal contour masking underlying enamel/dentin crown outline
OverlapRule: Frequently overlaps/co-occurs above CLS0004 (Endodontic treatment), CLS0001 (Implant), or CLS0008 (Apical periodontitis)
Examples: DS0001 train/valid/test/external class 1 (legend.txt verified in STEP-013)
Approver: Ms Faiza Feroz + Dental Review Team + M. Al Shabah + A. Anik (2026-11-19)

Name: DS0001_Obturation
Definition: Direct intracoronal restorative filling (amalgam/composite/glass-ionomer) visible as localized coronal radiopacity on 2D OPG (UMFIH source id=2; N=5262 boxes)
Inclusion: Occlusal, proximal, or cervical intracoronal direct restorations clearly denser than surrounding enamel/dentin
Exclusion: Full-coverage crowns/bridges (CLS0002), root canal gutta-percha obturations (CLS0004), or radiolucent caries (CLS0005)
BoxRule: Tight focal AABB around the intracoronal filling material only, not the entire tooth (mean_w=0.035)
VisibilityRule: Localized radiopaque restorative density within crown boundaries
OverlapRule: May abut or partially overlap CLS0005 (secondary Carious lesion) or sit coronally above CLS0004 (Endodontic treatment); never merged with caries
Examples: DS0001 train/valid/test/external class 2 (legend.txt verified in STEP-013)
Approver: Ms Faiza Feroz + Dental Review Team + M. Al Shabah + A. Anik (2026-11-19)

Name: DS0001_Endodontic_Treatment
Definition: Radiopaque root canal filling material (gutta-percha/sealer/intracanal post) within pulp chamber and root canals on 2D OPG (UMFIH source id=3; N=3692 boxes)
Inclusion: Complete or partial radiopaque endodontic root canal fillings and intracanal posts along root trajectory
Exclusion: Coronal-only fillings (CLS0003), endosseous implants (CLS0001), or retrograde apical surgical fillings alone (CLS0011)
BoxRule: Tight AABB spanning the radiopaque root canal filling extent within the tooth root(s)
VisibilityRule: Linear/tapering high-density radiopaque canal fill visible inside root outline
OverlapRule: Commonly co-occurs with coronal CLS0002/CLS0003 and apical CLS0008 (Apical periodontitis) or CLS0011 (Apical surgery)
Approver: Ms Faiza Feroz + Dental Review Team + M. Al Shabah + A. Anik (2026-11-19)

Name: DS0001_Carious_Lesion
Definition: Radiographically visible coronal, interproximal, or root-surface radiolucency consistent with dental caries cavitation/demineralization on 2D OPG (UMFIH source id=4; N=3589 boxes)
Inclusion: Focal radiolucent loss of enamel/dentin tooth structure on occlusal, proximal, or cervical surfaces visible on 2D OPG
Exclusion: Non-cavitated clinical-only white-spot lesions (P0032), cervical burnout artifacts, or radiopaque fillings (CLS0003)
BoxRule: Tight focal lesion-level AABB enclosing the radiolucent carious defect only (not whole tooth)
VisibilityRule: Requires discernible localized radiolucent contour defect on 2D OPG; radiographic observation only (not tactile chairside diagnosis)
OverlapRule: May be adjacent to CLS0003 (secondary caries next to filling) or coronal to CLS0008 (pulp-involved tooth with apical lesion)
Approver: Ms Faiza Feroz + Dental Review Team + M. Al Shabah + A. Anik (2026-11-19)

Name: DS0001_Bone_Resorption
Definition: Horizontal or vertical alveolar crestal bone loss visible around tooth roots on 2D OPG (UMFIH source id=5; N=3858 boxes)
Inclusion: Localized angular/vertical or segmental crestal bone level reduction below normal cementoenamel junction reference
Exclusion: Periapical radiolucencies confined to root apex (CLS0008) or interradicular furcation-only defects (CLS0010)
BoxRule: Tight AABB over the resorbed interdental/alveolar crestal bone segment (mean_w=0.021; drop 2 zero-area boxes cleanly)
VisibilityRule: Visible lowering/radiolucent defect of alveolar crest relative to adjacent CEJ; flagged for diffuse boundary evaluation in GAP0003
OverlapRule: May overlap root surfaces containing CLS0004, CLS0009, or CLS0010
Examples: DS0001 train/valid/test/external class 5 (legend.txt verified in STEP-013)
Approver: Ms Faiza Feroz + Dental Review Team + M. Al Shabah + A. Anik (2026-11-19)

Name: DS0001_Impacted_Tooth
Definition: Unerupted or partially erupted tooth (predominantly third molars or canines) blocked from normal functional eruption on 2D OPG (UMFIH source id=6; N=1088 boxes)
Inclusion: Mesioangular, distoangular, horizontal, or vertical impacted/embedded permanent teeth within alveolar bone
Exclusion: Normally erupting mixed-dentition tooth buds or fully erupted malaligned teeth
BoxRule: Tight whole-tooth AABB enclosing crown and root(s) of the impacted tooth (mean_w=0.061)
VisibilityRule: Complete or partial bony/soft-tissue impaction with abnormal angulation or obstruction clearly visible on OPG
OverlapRule: May overlap adjacent second molar roots or mandibular canal
Examples: DS0001 train/valid/test/external class 6 (legend.txt verified in STEP-013)
Approver: Ms Faiza Feroz + Dental Review Team + M. Al Shabah + A. Anik (2026-11-19)

Name: DS0001_Apical_Periodontitis
Definition: Periapical radiolucency (widened PDL space / periapical granuloma / cyst / abscess appearance) at tooth root apex on 2D OPG (UMFIH source id=7; N=1259 boxes)
Inclusion: Well-defined or ill-defined radiolucent area surrounding the apex of one or more tooth roots
Exclusion: Normal mental foramen, incisive canal, maxillary sinus recess, or interradicular furcation lesion (CLS0010)
BoxRule: Tight focal AABB enclosing the periapical radiolucency at the root apex
VisibilityRule: Distinct periapical bone rarefaction/radiolucency at root tip; radiographic finding only (histological cyst vs granuloma not claimed)
OverlapRule: Often sits at the apical end of CLS0004 (Endodontic treatment) or CLS0009 (Root fragment)
Approver: Ms Faiza Feroz + Dental Review Team + M. Al Shabah + A. Anik (2026-11-19)

Name: DS0001_Root_Fragment
Definition: Retained dental root remnant or severely broken-down root without intact clinical crown on 2D OPG (UMFIH source id=8; N=1502 boxes)
Inclusion: Subgingival or alveolar retained root tips and crownless root remnants
Exclusion: Intact teeth, crowned roots with prosthetic superstructure (CLS0002), or endosseous implants (CLS0001)
BoxRule: Tight AABB enclosing the retained root fragment structure
VisibilityRule: Visible root morphology lacking an anatomical or prosthetic clinical crown
OverlapRule: May coexist with CLS0004 (prior canal fill inside root remnant) or CLS0008 (apical radiolucency)
Approver: Ms Faiza Feroz + Dental Review Team + M. Al Shabah + A. Anik (2026-11-19)

Name: DS0001_Furcation_Lesion
Definition: Interradicular radiolucency in the furcation area of multi-rooted molars/premolars on 2D OPG (UMFIH source id=9; N=328 boxes)
Inclusion: Radiolucent bone loss situated specifically between diverging roots at the furcation fornix
Exclusion: Purely apical radiolucencies (CLS0008) or marginal crestal-only bone loss not entering furcation (CLS0006)
BoxRule: Tight focal AABB centered on the interradicular furcation radiolucency
VisibilityRule: Visible dark radiolucency between roots of multi-rooted tooth (minority class: 328 total boxes)
OverlapRule: Nested between roots of molars that may also carry CLS0002/CLS0003/CLS0004
Approver: Ms Faiza Feroz + Dental Review Team + M. Al Shabah + A. Anik (2026-11-19)

Name: DS0001_Apical_Surgery
Definition: Radiographic evidence of apicoectomy / root-end resection with or without retrograde root-end filling on 2D OPG (UMFIH source id=10; N=91 boxes)
Inclusion: Resected/beveled root apex and/or dense focal retrograde apical plug
Exclusion: Standard orthograde root canal filling without root-end resection (CLS0004)
BoxRule: Tight focal AABB around the resected root apex / retrograde filling site
VisibilityRule: Visible blunted/resected root tip or radiopaque retrograde seal (ultra-rare: 91 total boxes; flagged for UD04/UD13 support rules)
OverlapRule: Overlaps apical termination of CLS0004
Approver: Ms Faiza Feroz + Dental Review Team + M. Al Shabah + A. Anik (2026-11-19)

Name: DS0001_Root_Resorption_EXCLUDED
Definition: Internal or external pathological root resorption (UMFIH source id=11; ONLY N=5 boxes in train and 0 in valid/test/external)
Inclusion: None — proposed EXCLUDED from trainable/evaluated ontology under UD04 due to extreme statistical unsupportability (N=5 total, 0 eval) and 2D OPG diagnostic ambiguity

VisibilityRule: Insufficient support (N=5 across 1808 OPGs) for valid train/val/test evaluation (OS §4.4, §6.1, §7.2)
OverlapRule: N/A (excluded)
Examples: DS0001 internal_train class 11 (5 boxes only; 0 in valid/test/external)
Approver: Ms Faiza Feroz + Dental Review Team + M. Al Shabah + A. Anik (2026-11-19)

Name: DS0001_Orthodontic_Device
Definition: Fixed orthodontic brackets, archwires, bands, or retainers visible on 2D OPG (UMFIH source id=12; N=533 boxes; remapped to index 11 after CLS0012 exclusion)
Inclusion: Metallic/ceramic orthodontic bracket arrays, archwires, lingual retainers, and orthodontic appliances
Exclusion: Maxillofacial osteosynthesis plates/screws (CLS0014) or prosthetic bridges (CLS0002)
BoxRule: AABB enclosing the orthodontic appliance/archwire segment or bracket group (mean_w=0.277)
VisibilityRule: High-contrast metallic wire/bracket pattern spanning tooth crowns

Approver: Ms Faiza Feroz + Dental Review Team + M. Al Shabah + A. Anik (2026-11-19)

Name: DS0001_Surgical_Device
Definition: Maxillofacial surgical fixation hardware (osteosynthesis miniplates, bone screws, wires, reconstruction plates) on 2D OPG (UMFIH source id=13; N=1272 boxes; remapped to index 12)
Inclusion: Metallic osteosynthesis plates, fixation screws, intermaxillary fixation screws, and surgical wires in mandible/maxilla
Exclusion: Endosseous dental implants for tooth replacement (CLS0001) or orthodontic brackets/wires (CLS0013)

Name: DS0002_Impacted

Name: DS0002_Caries
Definition: Superficial to moderate dental caries annotated at tooth level in DENTEX (categories_3 id=1; N=2189 boxes, 62.0% of Track B boxes)
Inclusion: Teeth exhibiting enamel or outer/middle dentin carious radiolucency not yet classified as pulp-threatening Deep Caries (CLS0018)
Exclusion: Deep caries approaching pulp chamber (CLS0018) or intact/restored non-carious teeth

VisibilityRule: Visible coronal/interproximal radiolucency without deep pulpal encroachment; note boundary ambiguity vs CLS0018 in P0014/P0036

Name: DS0002_Periapical_Lesion
Definition: Periapical radiolucency / lesion annotated in DENTEX (categories_3 id=2; N=158 boxes, 4.5% of Track B boxes — 14:1 minority skew)
Inclusion: Teeth/apices exhibiting periapical radiolucent bone changes in DENTEX
Exclusion: Healthy apices or isolated coronal caries without apical pathology

VisibilityRule: Visible apical radiolucency; minority support (158 total boxes -> ~24 test boxes at 15% split) requires stratified group split check at G07

Name: DS0002_Deep_Caries
Definition: Advanced/deep dental caries extending into inner dentin near or into the pulp chamber in DENTEX (categories_3 id=3; N=578 boxes, 16.4%)
Inclusion: Extensive coronal radiolucency penetrating deep dentin toward pulp horn/chamber
Exclusion: Superficial/moderate caries (CLS0016) or crownless retained roots
BoxRule: Tooth-enclosing COCO AABB per DENTEX annotation convention
VisibilityRule: Large radiolucent cavitation reaching inner third of dentin or pulp contour; can be pooled with CLS0016 under HC01 for binary caries bridge
OverlapRule: May co-occur with CLS0017 (Periapical Lesion)
Approver: Ms Faiza Feroz + Dental Review Team + M. Al Shabah + A. Anik (2026-11-19)

Name: DS0003_Caries_Tooth
Definition: Carious tooth annotated with whole-tooth bounding box in Rahman 2024 Dhaka cohort (source id=0 proven via SHA-256 bijection; N=194 boxes in 117 OPGs)
Inclusion: Tooth with radiographically visible carious cavitation on photographed OPG film (P0024)
Exclusion: Healthy teeth (CLS0024) or severely broken-down crown/root remnants (CLS0023)

VisibilityRule: Visible radiolucent caries defect on handheld-photographed OPG film

Name: DS0003_Infection_Tooth

Inclusion: Tooth exhibiting periapical radiolucency/abscess surrounding root apex (P0024 Section 3.1)
Exclusion: Uninfected carious teeth (CLS0019) or healthy teeth (CLS0024)
BoxRule: Whole-tooth + periapical zone YOLO AABB (mean_w=0.089, mean_h=0.245)
VisibilityRule: Visible periapical darkness around root apex on photographed OPG film (minority class: 37 boxes in 23 OPGs)

Name: DS0003_Impacted_Tooth

Inclusion: Unerupted/blocked teeth (predominantly third molars) in abnormal jaw positions (P0024)
Exclusion: Normally erupted teeth (CLS0024)

Name: DS0003_Fractured_Tooth
Definition: Fractured tooth in Rahman 2024 Dhaka cohort (source id=3 proven via SHA-256 bijection; N=14 boxes in 13 OPGs)
Inclusion: Teeth with visible crown, pulp, or root fracture lines/trauma (P0024 Section 3.1)
Exclusion: Gross carious crown destruction without fracture line (CLS0023 BDC/BDR)
BoxRule: Whole-tooth YOLO AABB (mean_w=0.063, mean_h=0.230)
VisibilityRule: Ultra-rare class (N=14 boxes across 13 OPGs -> only ~2 test boxes at 15% split); flagged for UD04 retention vs exclusion/reporting caveat

Name: DS0003_BDC_BDR
Definition: Broken-Down Crown / Broken-Down Root (BDC/BDR) in Rahman 2024 Dhaka cohort (source id=4 proven via SHA-256 bijection; N=97 boxes in 50 OPGs)
Inclusion: Teeth with severe structural loss of clinical crown down to cervical/root level or retained root remnants (P0024)
Exclusion: Intact carious crowns (CLS0019) or healthy teeth (CLS0024)

VisibilityRule: Severely destructed crown/root remnant visible on OPG
OverlapRule: Maps conceptually to HC04 (Residual Root / BDC)

Definition: Annotated Healthy Tooth in Rahman 2024 Dhaka cohort (source id=5 proven via SHA-256 bijection; N=651 boxes in 221 OPGs — selective/non-exhaustive)
Inclusion: Intact enamel/crown/root with normal alignment and no decay/infection (P0024; ~2.8 healthy teeth labeled per OPG as reference objects)
